description: Platform keys the verifier trusts (ADR-009, ADR-015, ADR-016). Relayer entries are checked against block.timestamp of the anchor; receipt entries against the receipt's self-declared acceptedAt, which is a consistency check only. Rotation = add an entry; revocation = set revokedAt. Revocation is off-chain only: PostAnchor has no admin. PLACEHOLDERS ONLY: every address below is the zero address and must be replaced before use; a verifier must reject the zero address.
